text:
The gravity hypothesis is Open. Do not recast any sentence on this page as a gravity theorem. scientific_breakthrough: false.

Primitive question

What if gravity isn’t fundamentally a force between things? What if it’s the price of making everything belong to the same reality?

Global compatibility is the constraint. Gravity would be the reorganization required to satisfy it. No spacetime required at the primitive level. No gravity claim yet. That is why Retained Atlas exists: to keep that question testable without letting a headline run ahead of the harness.

What is not assumed

Spacetime as a primitive.
ADM momentum as given.
Einstein equations as the starting algebra.
A fitted force law.

Signal over hype. Claim badges. Falsification page. Four Supported harnesses. Gravity still a candidate. Folding not solved. X remains the archive.

Progress vs a result

Progress is a named gate, a residual, a sealed door, or a new lawful question. A result, here, would be a derived Einstein correspondence with Gravity’s constraints identified. That has not happened. Pillar 3 is OPEN. Cite Falsification for kill rules. Cite Live gates for HEAD. Cite Emergent gravity only as a candidate.
